Subject: Engagement outline, success metrics & proposed schedule for AmplifyTech POC

Tom / Diane — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed evaluation plan so we can lock dates and owners. I attached a short evaluation outline and the POC checklist for your team.

Goal: validate Redwood as the low-latency, cost-predictable inference backend for AmplifyTech's routing assistant (intent classification + short-form generation)

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Intent classification accuracy >= 92% on Amplify's labeled test set
- Response quality / hallucination rate within your QA thresholds (we'll use your evaluation prompts)
- P95 latency < 400ms (128-token request profile)
- Sustained throughput: 25–35 concurrent user sessions
- Cost target: <$0.40 per 1k tokens during evaluation (reportable by token category)
- Security: SOC 2 evidence review passed; support for VPC private deployment or dedicated capacity

High-level 4-week plan (recommended):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): sign trial SOW / CDA, exchange network contacts
- Week 1 (kickoff & provisioning): environment setup, sample dataset ingestion, tokenization mapping
- Week 2 (integration & baseline): run baseline evals, iterate prompts and scoring, quick tuning
- Week 3 (scale & reliability): load tests, latency profiling, batching configuration
- Week 4 (acceptance & handoff): final metrics review, knowledge transfer, next-steps for production rollout

Owners: Jordan (commercial lead), Karthik (technical lead / on-call for runbook), Marissa (support & success manager)

Ask: Can you confirm (1) the success criteria above, (2) whether Feb 6 start works for you, and (3) who on your infra/security team I should loop in for the pre-kickoff checklist?

Attachments: redwood-eval-outline-amplifytech.pdf, redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m sync if helpful.

— Jordan

Tom — great questions, answered inline below and attached a couple of artifacts (network config snippet + POC checklist with sample dataset guidance).

1) VPC / Private options: We support three modes for evaluations: (a) Hosted API (fastest), (b) Dedicated capacity (reservation-backed in our cloud), and (c) Private VPC deployment (customer-managed networking). For your residency requirements we can provision a Private evaluation environment — we typically do a short-lived VPC peering or VPN tunnel for the 4-week window.

2) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II audited. I'll share the SOC summary and the controls mapping in the Drive link; we can also sign an NDA/CDA if helpful.

3) Sample dataset: 20k–40k labeled rows is ideal for stable classification metrics. Your ~30k set is perfect. Please format CSV with columns: id, text, label. Attachments include a tokenization note — we'll run a mapping pass and return a tokenized sample.

4) Quotas: For a dedicated POC we can configure throughput to meet the 25–35 concurrent session target. No automatic throttling will be imposed for that reserved window; we'll monitor and flag any abnormal usage.

Next steps I can action:
- Attach: network-config-snippet.txt (suggested firewall & peering rules)
- Attach: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (detailed pre-kickoff steps)
- Kickoff proposed for Mon, Feb 6 — please confirm Diane and infra contact

If Feb 6 works I will book time for the technical kickoff and pre-kick checklist walkthrough.
